einstellungen.text: The wheel turns under Henrik's hands. Your bus is driving itself.
Henrik stomps on the brake with everything he's got. Nothing happens.
The bus doesn't speed up and doesn't slow down. Exactly thirty, right on schedule.
You run to the door and pull the emergency handle. The door stays shut.
You grab the emergency hammer and hit the window. The glass holds. Not one scratch.
Outside there's only black water now. No shore. No lights.
From above, it would look like a glowing bus driving across the lake.
Your phone buzzes. Ben. You home? Your location says middle of the reservoir.
You've shared locations since you were twelve. Ben never asked before. Tonight he does.
You type: help me. The message stays gray.
You sit back down and look into the window.
The figures have moved closer. But now there are only two.
Next to you, it turns cold. Your sleeve gets wet, though nothing is touching it.
In the window, the seat next to you is taken. A boy. Wet hair. A red schoolbag.
